steps.title: Allow this network
steps.text: Plain DNS only works for a network whose address you have claimed. Turn Plain DNS on for the Endpoint, then claim and prove this network's address on the Addresses page.

steps.title: Open the router's admin page
steps.text: Open the router's address in a browser and sign in. The address and password are usually printed under the device.

steps.title: Find the DNS section
steps.text: In the Internet, WAN or DHCP settings look for DNS and choose manual.

steps.title: Enter the addresses
steps.text: Put the first in the first DNS field and the second in the second. Every device behind the router uses them.

steps.title: Save and renew the connection
steps.text: Press Save. Disconnect and reconnect your devices so they take the new DNS.

steps.title: Check the setup
steps.text: A few seconds after saving, run this check on a device connected to this router to see that it uses this Endpoint.
